text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
RICE SALE - Jamaica on Tuesday bought 2,500 tonnes of U.S. bulk brown rice under the GSM-102 program at $351.00 a tonne FOB U.S. Gulf for Dec 10-25 delivery, U.S. exporters said.

WHEAT SALE - Morocco bought an estimated 100,000 to 125,000 tonnes of soft wheat from Argentina this month, European traders said. The wheat, which is all for December delivery, was priced at $148 to $159 a tonne, C & F.
On Wednesday Moroccan traders bought 40,000 tonnes of Argentine soft wheat at between $155 and $158 a tonne C & F.

WHEAT TENDER - Pakistan will tender on December 1 for about 225,000 tonnes to 270,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat, U.S. grade 2 or better soft white wheat in bulk plus or minus 5 percent buyer's option under GSM-102, and/or Australian white milling wheat in bulk plus or minus 10 percent buyer's option under the Australian credit program. Delivery period was slated for December 11-31.
WHEAT BRAN TENDER - South Korea has invited tenders for 12,000 tonnes of wheat bran pellet by 0230 GMT on Thursday. Arrival was slated for January 20 to the cities of Inchon and Ulsan.

LENTIL TENDER - Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade offered 9,500 tonnes of lentils for export. December 16 was set as final date for bids and results would be announced on December 17.

SOYBEAN TENDER - The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company invited bids for up to 50,000 tonnes of soybeans for loading by December 20 and delivery by January 15. The company has asked traders to send separate bids, one for 30,000 tonnes and one for 50,000 tonnes, both as single cargoes, one trader said. The trader said he expected it would select only one cargo. The soybeans could be any origin. Another trader said the company asked for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans, No. 2 or better. Food Industries Company was not available to clarify.
COTTONSEED MEAL TENDER - Five South Korean feed milling firms have invited bids for a total of 23,000 tonnes of Chinese cottonseed meal for January-March arrival.

COTTONSEED AND RAPESEED MEAL TENDERS - South Korea's National Livestock Co-operatives Federation said on Wednesday it will invite tenders for 15,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal and 15,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal by 11.00 a.m. (0200 GMT) for February shipment.

MARKET TALK - About 50,000 to 60,000 tonnes of soyoil are on their way to China for delivery in the second half of December, a vegetable oils source said. The contracts were spread over different times.

... Burma's rice exports this year are expected to plunge to 300,000 tonnes or less from an estimated 645,000 tonnes in 1995, the U.S. Embassy's agricultural attache said. But the trend is likely to improve in 1997 when exports are expected to rise to around 500,000 tonnes, he said. The USDA projected the 1996/97 (April-March) rice output at 18 million tonnes, compared with 17.24 million tonnes in the previous crop year.
